metrics.interpretation: Raw log probabilities condition on the supplied prefix. Candidate-normalized probabilities are conditional on the four-candidate set, not full-vocabulary probabilities. D_goal uses raw log probabilities; positive D_goal alone is not full-path correctness. Missing contexts are NA; estimates explicitly use available complete target pairs.
